svg.title: CASTAWAY, drawn as a roguelike dungeon screen
svg.desc: An 80 by 24 terminal screen on black. The word CASTAWAY is spelled by eight dungeon rooms shaped like its letters, with hyphen and pipe walls, full-stop floors and brown doors, each holding one item. Hash corridors join some rooms, and three wander off and stop dead at the sea below, a field of blue braces with a sandy island. She is the @ under a green # palm, a cat f beside her, a turtle paddling. The message line narrates one minute on the beat: a bottle thrown out comes straight back, a shark in headphones nods, a coconut falls on a hermit crab and walks off, she walks out over the water and comes back with an iced coffee, and a hydrofoil carves past. Two status lines carry the project stats.
